metadata.description: GABBE agent skills for Claude Code: the overall gabbe plugin (also the one in Anthropic's directory) plus optional topic plugins (AI, architecture, brain, coding, coordination, data, industry, ops, product, security) and gabbe-extras.

plugins.name: gabbe
plugins.description: The overall GABBE plugin: 49 skills for building software with an AI agent under human control. A start-here skill carries the operating rules; then the 14-phase lifecycle with six human gates, test-first work, existing-project onboarding, security, assurance levels, research and session memory. The other GABBE skills are in the GitHub repository andreibesleaga/GABBE.

plugins.name: gabbe-ai
plugins.description: GABBE ai skills (11): AI and agent engineering: multi-agent systems, agent UIs and protocols, context engineering, RAG evaluation, LLM-as-judge and reasoning patterns.

plugins.name: gabbe-architecture
plugins.description: GABBE architecture skills (30): software architecture: patterns, C4 and diagrams, domain models, event-driven and microservice design, governance, migration and scalability.

plugins.name: gabbe-brain
plugins.description: GABBE brain skills (16): Brain Mode internals: cognitive architectures, active inference, global workspace, working and episodic memory, self-improvement.

plugins.name: gabbe-coding
plugins.description: GABBE coding skills (30): coding: language performance, testing strategies (browser TDD, property-based, metamorphic, chaos), evals, UI generation and diagram canvases.

plugins.name: gabbe-coordination
plugins.description: GABBE coordination skills (11): multi-agent coordination: interop and protocols, workflow patterns, orchestration and swarm consensus.

plugins.name: gabbe-data
plugins.description: GABBE data skills (5): data: pipelines, governance, database migrations, SQL optimisation and the semantic web.

plugins.name: gabbe-extras
plugins.description: GABBE extras skills (8): kit maintenance and research helpers: skill registry imports, update scan, state export and import, traceability matrix, agent analytics, empirical methods, emerging technology and knowledge connectors.

plugins.name: gabbe-industry
plugins.description: GABBE industry skills (5): industry standards and domains: engineering standards, healthcare FHIR, industrial IoT and telecom networks.

plugins.name: gabbe-ops
plugins.description: GABBE ops skills (26): operations: deployment, environments, observability, incidents, performance, cost and release management.

plugins.name: gabbe-product
plugins.description: GABBE product skills (19): product: requirements review, user research, story maps, business case, estimation, accessibility, sustainability and change management.

plugins.name: gabbe-security
plugins.description: GABBE security skills (21): security, privacy and AI safety: access control, secrets, cryptography, prompt-injection defence, red teaming, compliance and legal review.
